subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], This email is to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on July 15th, 2022. Your departure time is 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please ensure you arrive at least 2 hours before your flight for check-in. If you have any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact us at [airline contact]. We hope you have a pleasant journey! Regards, [Airline Name]
